scope: All units read: text for sense, translation and word glosses against the text. The text was not compared with the source page. The long last translation (flag T-RATIO) carries an editorial note about the 108th name.

items.issue: The name was written Ahaspati; the text has aharpatiḥ.
Agnigarbha was glossed “womb of fire” (translation and word gloss); Skanda is the child Agni carried. Found while reviewing the nāmāvali.
items.change: Now “the child Fire carried” in both.

items.issue: Verse 14 reads kāraṇotpattidehaḥ (the Wikisource text). The TTD nāmāvali, now checked against its page image, reads kāraṇopāttadeha (“who took on a body for a purpose”), which is also the usual reading. Two other TTD readings were already adopted in this verse.
options: A. Adopt kāraṇopāttadehaś ca, with the meaning “who took on a body for a purpose”.
